source_units.text: Explain the judging priorities of a fictional dessert contest.
A balanced and explanatory tone suits this piece.
The full text must be between 55 and 85 words.
Use this fictional material: The fictional dessert contest places texture first and presentation second.
There are no points for size.
Explain that a small, well-balanced entry can outperform a large decorative one.
Required wording, verbatim: "texture first", "presentation second", "no points for size".
The audience is judges in the imaginary Crumb Crown contest.
